work.title: XXIII Discs, Yellow
work.description: Variant of the XXIII series in yellow: four gold compact discs arrange diamond-formation across the centre over a layered field of warplane drawings, equipment fragments and red blocks. Black-and-white perforated borders frame the top and bottom; a pink scribbled column drops at lower left, with a target medallion at right.
work.composition: diamond disc cluster on layered yellow ground
